title: Optimization Inverse Spectral Problem for the Schrödinger Operator on a Compact Graph
summary: We study the optimization inverse spectral problem (OISP) for the first $m$ eigenvalues of the Schrödinger operator on a compact metric graph. We prove the existence of a solution for every strictly increasing finite set of prescribed eigenvalues. On a graph without cycles, we obtain a representation of the optimal correction as a linear combination of squared eigenfunctions, provided that the selected eigenvalues are simple and separated from the next eigenvalue.
